text: 今天，国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，商务部介绍所谓“产能过剩”问题中方立场有关情况，并答记者问。 发布会上介绍，中国产业发展是增进各国民生福祉的助推剂，中国产业快速发展为全球提供了高质量、高效能、高性价比的丰富产品，为各国消费者提供了更稳定、更多元的选择。
text_en: Today, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where the Ministry of Commerce introduced China's position on the so-called "overcapacity" issue and answered questions. The press conference stated that China's industrial development serves as a booster for improving the well-being of people in various countries, and China's rapid industrial growth has provided the world with high-quality, high-efficiency, and cost-effective abundant products, offering consumers in various countries more stable and diverse choices.
